column2: a sprite sheet of ONE character, 2D side-scrolling action game art in the style of Dead Cells: dark fantasy with neon cyber accents, hand-painted look, crisp dark outlines, strong silhouettes. The character: a nimble hooded warrior in a dark blue tattered cloak and scarf with a glowing cyan flame-like visor instead of a face, leather boots and gloves, EMPTY HANDS (no weapons). Side view facing right, the same character, same size and proportions in every cell. 5 columns and 2 rows, 10 poses in this order: row 1: standing idle; running pose A (left leg forward); running pose B (legs together mid-stride); running pose C (right leg forward); jumping up with knees bent. Row 2: falling with arms up; curled into a ball for a dodge roll; hit and recoiling backwards; melee attack lunge with right arm swung fully forward; standing with left arm stretched forward as if holding a bow. arranged in a strict even grid with wide empty gaps between sprites, every sprite fully inside its own cell and centered, nothing overlapping, fully transparent background (real PNG alpha), no ground shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines

a sprite sheet of game weapons, 2D side-scrolling action game art in the style of Dead Cells: dark fantasy with neon cyber accents, hand-painted look, crisp dark outlines, strong silhouettes.
